import html # Base HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def build_html_page(client_input: str) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML page by embedding the user-provided content into the predefined template. The input is escaped to prevent XSS or script injection attacks. Parameters: client_input (str): The content supplied by the user. Returns: str: A complete HTML page with the escaped user content inserted. """ # Escape special HTML characters to neutralize any malicious input. safe_content = html.escape(client_input, quote=True) # Format the template with the sanitized content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
